answer_1.quote: Thus, developing computational models that generate sarcastic messages could impact many downstream applications, such as better conversational agents and creative or humorous content creation.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation using several criteria: 1) how sarcastic is the generated message; 2) how humorous it is; 3) how creative it is; and 4) how grammatical it is. Evaluation via Amazon's Mechanical Turk (MTurk) shows that our system is better...
answer_4.guideline: Each criteria was rated on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 5 (very).
